#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cmath>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n, B;
    cin >> n >> B;
    vector<int> arr(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> arr[i];
    }

    int cut = 0;
    int odd = 0;
    int even = 0;
    vector<int> money;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
            even++;
        } else {
            odd++;
        }

        if (even == odd && even != 0 && i != n - 1) {
            money.push_back(abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]));
        }
    }

    sort(money.begin(), money.end());

    for (int x : money) {
        if (B >= x) {
            cut++;
            B -= x;
        }
    }

    cout << cut << endl;

    return 0;
}
